dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agency leadership positions and administrative personnel within the NTIA and Department of Commerce.
dimensions.evidence: The National Telecommunications and Information Administration Organization Act (47 U.S.C. 901 et seq) is amended by striking Assistant Secretary each place it appears and inserting Under Secretary.

dimensions.assessment: Changes administrative titles and reporting processes without directly altering civil rights or broad public regulations.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this subsection or the amendments made by this subsection may be construed to expand or contract the authority of the Secretary, the Under Secretary, the NTIA, or the Commission.

dimensions.assessment: Sets specific authorization of appropriations levels for fiscal years 2025 and 2026.
dimensions.evidence: inserting $57,000,000 for fiscal year 2025 and $57,000,000 for fiscal year 2026

dimensions.assessment: Amends existing statutes regarding leadership structure, statutory office establishment, and consolidated reporting.
dimensions.evidence: The bill reauthorizes the National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) through FY2026 and makes certain changes to its leadership structure.

dimensions.assessment: Provides funding and organizational changes extending through fiscal year 2026.
dimensions.evidence: reauthorizes the National Telecommunications and Information Administration (NTIA) through FY2026

missing_information: Specific details on potential long-term budgetary offsets or broader economic consequences outside of the authorized appropriations amount.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill reauthorizes the NTIA through FY2026 at $57,000,000 per year, updates agency leadership titles, and consolidates reporting requirements.
